informal_restatement.author: Formalia 维护者（据 formal-conjectures 文档注释翻译）
informal_restatement.text: 每棵树都有优美标号：有 m 条边的树，可以给顶点标上 0 到 m 中互不相同的数，使各条边两端标号之差的绝对值恰好取遍 1 到 m。
informal_restatement.text_en:
Every tree admits a graceful labeling.

A graceful labeling of a tree $T$ with $m$ edges is an injective map $f : V \to \{0, \dots, m\}$
such that the multiset of absolute differences $|f(u) - f(v)|$ over edges $\{u,v\}$ of $T$
equals $\{1, \dots, m\}$.
